column.name: report_sql
column.value: select msat.id as "Transaction ID", TO_CHAR(msat.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Value Date", TO_CHAR(msat.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Transaction Date", debit_acc.gl_code as "Debit Account", debit_acc."name" as "Debit Acct Title", credit_acc.gl_code as "Credit Account", credit_acc."name" as "Credit Acct Title", msat.amount as "Transaction Value", rev.enum_value as "Transaction Type", case when msat.is_reversed = false then 'Transaction Successful' else 'Transaction Reversed' end as "Status", mn.note as "Narration", mpcs.maker_id as "Maker ID", mpcs.checker_id as "Checker ID" from m_savings_account_transaction msat join m_savings_account msa on msat.savings_account_id = msa.id left join acc_gl_journal_entry debit on debit.savings_transaction_id = msat.id and debit.type_enum = 2 left join acc_gl_account debit_acc on debit.account_id = debit_acc.id left join acc_gl_journal_entry credit on credit.savings_transaction_id = msat.id and credit.type_enum = 1 left join acc_gl_account credit_acc on credit.account_id = credit_acc.id left join m_note mn on mn.savings_account_transaction_id = msat.id left join r_enum_value rev on rev.enum_id = msat.transaction_type_enum and rev.enum_name = 'savings_transaction_type_enum' left join m_portfolio_command_source mpcs on mpcs.resource_id = msat.id and mpcs.entity_name = 'SAVINGSACCOUNT' and mpcs.action_name in ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL') where (msa.product_id = ${savingsProductId} or -1 = ${savingsProductId}) order by msat.transaction_date desc

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Transaction Listing')
